title: Villa Wolf

terrainReference.basis: Original sampled terrain on the uphill side of the named ruin point, near the estimated access elevation.

mapIdentity.provider: Named OpenStreetMap Villa Wolf ruins and adjoining Waszkiewicza Park.
mapIdentity.scope: The native ruins node anchors the house in Park Waszkiewicza. The ruin and overlook mark modern points; the original building envelope and its rotation are author estimates constrained by the documented slope and river-facing rooms.

note: The two-city cultural register records the clinker construction and surviving foundations. Ivan Brambilla’s study identifies the family, service and living volumes, glazed southwest terrace doors, flat roofs, Gothic brick bond, sunken garden and service wing.
